capabilities: Mirror Getnote notes to Markdown files organized by knowledge base
Push the current note or selected files to Getnote
Browse, filter, search, create, tag, and categorize notes in a built-in dashboard
Schedule or manually trigger pull synchronization with hash-based change detection
Handle conflicts, download attachments, and clean orphaned attachment files
disambiguation: Not a general cross-device vault sync; it only synchronizes content with the Getnote service.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Push writes are never retried automatically to avoid duplicate note creation, and credentials are stored in data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a Getnote knowledge base mirrored locally or to push vault edits back to Getnote.
summary: Two-way sync plugin that mirrors Getnote knowledge bases into a vault as Markdown files and lets users push selected notes back.
